description: Hand-labelled local retrieval regression corpus. English mechanisms, multilingual exact terminology, locator sections, and plausible distractors; no network or model-generated relevance labels.

chunks.title: Speculative decoding mechanism
chunks.text: The target model verifies draft tokens in parallel. An acceptance test commits the accepted prefix and discards the rejected suffix.

chunks.title: Speculative decoding overhead
chunks.text: Draft construction and target verification both consume compute. A large draft model can erase end-to-end throughput gains.

chunks.title: Latency metrics
chunks.text: Time to first token (TTFT) measures request arrival to the first output token. Time per output token (TPOT) measures the interval during subsequent decoding.

chunks.title: Serving results
chunks.text: Aggregate throughput counts completed output tokens per second across concurrent requests. It is distinct from per-request latency.

chunks.title: Dataset split integrity
chunks.text: Near-duplicate examples crossing train and test splits cause data leakage. Deduplication must precede splitting, and temporal leakage requires chronological evaluation.

chunks.title: Ablation experiments
chunks.text: Removing each component measures its contribution under the same compute budget and random seeds. Ablations do not establish train-test independence.

chunks.title: 메모리 분석
chunks.text: 키 값 캐시는 이전 토큰의 어텐션 키와 값을 저장한다. 긴 문맥과 큰 배치에서는 캐시 메모리 사용량이 증가한다.

chunks.title: 注意力机制
chunks.text: 注意力机制使用查询向量与键向量的相似度计算权重，再对值向量加权求和。

chunks.title: 評価指標
chunks.text: 再現率は正解文書のうち検索結果に含まれる割合を示す。適合率は検索結果のうち正解である割合を示す。

chunks.title: Implementation details
chunks.text: The qk_scale parameter rescales query-key dot products before softmax. Its default is the inverse square root of the attention head dimension.

chunks.title: Proof assumptions
chunks.text: The convergence theorem assumes a smooth convex objective with bounded gradient variance. The proof does not apply to an arbitrary nonconvex loss.

chunks.title: Hardware configuration
chunks.text: All measurements use the same GPU, driver, framework, and precision. Warm-up runs are excluded from the reported measurements.
